figmaModel.note: Public roots are typography presets around the nested Web Core Amount anatomy. Operation is internal and must not be inserted standalone.

code.reason: AmountStyles is intentionally a Figma-only preset family and has no direct code export.
code.fallback: For implementation intent, use the verified Web Core Amount API and map typography from the surrounding code context; do not invent an AmountStyles import.

ownerDecisions.decision: AmountStyles supports points. For points, Minor and Currency are hidden and Addon contains a correctly sized IconView.
ownerDecisions.pending: The exact point icon and Style-to-IconView size mapping will be defined by a separate points pattern.
